_comment: The roles who-iris's own processes bind: the lanes of the four IRIS CDN export diagrams (processes/iris-cdn-*.bpmn, who-iris#103). Each inherits the harness role it specialises, so it carries that role's skills too. Schema: cat-harness-tools/schemas/process/role-graph.ts; and the lanes and stores of the proposed GuidelineKG path (processes/optimus-kg-nightly*.bpmn, processes/kg-tool-adjudication.bpmn, who-iris#303).
name: who-iris

roles.title: IRIS CDN owner
roles.description: A person: decides the export's scope, budget and storage target. Nothing downstream widens what the owner approved.

roles.title: IRIS CDN Exporter
roles.description: The agent role. It plans, reviews and reports; it does not hold the signing key, and it never pushes to a WHO repository.

roles.title: Cloudflare R2 and CDN
roles.description: Object storage behind the CDN. Every object is named by its SHA-256 and served with an immutable cache policy; an object already present is never written again. Also serves did.json. A mechanical role, held to the contract its skills state.

roles.title: Cloudflare git (Artifacts)
roles.description: A git repository hosted on Cloudflare Artifacts, not GitHub. Holds the release history: BagIt tag files, signatures, the cursor, checkpoints and run reports. A mechanical role: written to, deciding nothing.

roles.title: Release signer
roles.description: Holds the P-256 private key (GitHub environment secret IRIS_CDN_SIGNING_JWK) and signs each changed item manifest and the release tag manifest. A mechanical role.

roles.title: IRIS CDN verifier
roles.description: Anyone. Resolves the key from the did:web DID document, never from the package, and checks its x5c chain up to WHO's signing key. Cannot reach it: the verdict is unknown, not verified.

roles.title: who-iris GuidelineKG path
roles.description: who-iris's side of the parallel GuidelineKG path (docs/optimus-kg-integration.md): the deterministic scripts that verify, diff, select, publish the work order and project the result, and the agent that adjudicates first, reviews the run and opens beans. Holds no Reducto, OpenAI or Azure key, ever. Proposed: most of its skills are not written yet, and the diagrams say so step by step.

roles.title: Zitnik lab (GuidelineKG)
roles.description: The Zitnik lab at Harvard, which runs GuidelineKG (mims-harvard/guideline-kg, pinned by commit) on its own Reducto and Azure OpenAI keys and publishes its result releases in its own repositories. An external party: who-iris instructs nothing here; the work order and the result release are the whole interface.

roles.title: Human reviewer (SME or editor)
roles.description: A person who rules on every recommendation-class or contraindication claim the two KG extractors disagree on, and on anything the agent found undecidable. The ruling is kept beside the agent's, never over it.

roles.title: GuidelineKG result release
roles.description: What the lab publishes per work order: guideline_kg.jsonl and a SHA-256 manifest naming the work order, the CDN release and the GuidelineKG commit. A mechanical role, held outside who-iris: read and verified, never written by who-iris.
